actual_observation: SIGTERM during a state commit can poison persistence and leave the last-confirmed memory phase building. Child shutdown and intent preservation still completed, but the CLI lacked an explicit uncertainty report.
fix: Report last_confirmed_in_process_state and disk_state_requires_reconciliation; never perform more writes in a poisoned process. Signal stop reports closed_requires_persistence_reconciliation.
deterministic_regression: Interrupt Journal directory fsync after an actual admitted native job, verify uncertainty output and exact recovery from disk.
